guitar.evidence: Buck Dharma is well known for adopting the headless Steinberger guitar in the early 1980s, alongside earlier Gibson SG use; reasonably documented but not as singularly iconic as top-tier signature pairings.

tone.target: dirty fuzz-rock riff with chorus/vibrato sheen
tone.profile: dirty fuzz-rock riff with chorus/vibrato sheen
tone.summary: A fuzzy, mid-focused signal chain using Fuzz/Red Haze into a UK 45 or UK 50 style amp, followed by Chorus and Tremolo to achieve the required modulated sheen.
